fields.options:
Used by the GitHub Actions merge gate. Endpoint: itgc.api.manage_change_gate.check_pr_approval. The endpoint is token-protected by default (fail-closed): callers must send the token in the X-ITGC-Token header, and if no token is configured every call is rejected. Tick Allow Public… above only if you intend the endpoint to be reachable without a token.

Generate a token: run openssl rand -hex 32 (or python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"), paste it above, and store the same value as the GitHub repo secret ITGC_GATE_TOKEN. Full setup steps: .github/MANAGE_CHANGE_GATE.md in the itgc app.
This will disable direct access to doctypes where roles can be modified: User, Role Profile.
